subject: ddl: enhance checkpoint management with chunk tracking (#64607)
summary: Reviewed diff vs first parent focusing on add-index ingest checkpointing. Change adds per-task chunk counters to CheckpointManager and removes a zero-row early-return so every scanned chunk produces a FinishChunk signal; this prevents premature watermark advancement/panic when a task’s last (or intermediate) chunk reports 0 rows while still requiring completion. No remaining Blocker/High issues found in correctness, concurrency, or checkpoint state-machine behavior within the touched DDL ingest path.
